steps.name: kiosk-shell
steps.summary: /kiosk shell. src/lib/client/api.ts: createSession, sendCommand (uuid commandId, Bearer), ping; ApiError with NETWORK on fetch failure and INTERNAL on non-JSON or unknown code. src/hooks/useSessionStream.ts: EventSource, snapshot keyed by sessionId. src/hooks/useKioskSession.ts: localStorage 'kibo.kiosk.<id>' via useSyncExternalStore; new session when absent, gone, expired, or resumed as paid; 10 s retry; 30 s ping, active = pointerdown in last 30 s; clockOffset; setClaimUrl. src/lib/kiosk/screen.ts kioskScreen() (unit-tested). src/lib/i18n/kiosk.ts kt(). src/components/kiosk/KioskCanvas.tsx: 1080x1920 scaled, --k-* vars, lang. KioskScreen.tsx: K1 attract (QR img with data-claim-url, startTouch, language row, large-text toggle via --k-fs 1.15), K2 dine (setDineOption, phone-connected line), one-line placeholder for menu/review/payment/done, errorCopy alert bar; root has data-screen. Kiosk text uses k-text-40/48/56/72 utilities in globals.css. src/app/kiosk/page.tsx reads searchParams under Suspense and passes KioskData to client KioskApp.tsx. I-033 logged (stream not reopened after a hard close). Not checked in a real browser yet (no Playwright until step 5).

steps.name: kiosk-menu
steps.summary: K3/K4/K5 + AI highlight. src/lib/kiosk/menu.ts (tested): formatWon, lineLabel (variant word only for multi-variant items; options in group then menu order), sheetSteps(item, variant|null, locale) (variant step if several variants, one step per group for the variant or all groups before one is chosen, a qty step for items with no choices; last step holds qty), draftSelections, sheetPrice (unitPriceOf x qty, first variant before a choice). i18n/kiosk.ts: menu/sheet/upsell strings, stepLabel ('2/4 단계 · 사이드'), variantWord. components/kiosk: MenuScreen (Header + toolbar with dine chip, small QR button -> QrSheet with data-claim-url, or '휴대폰 연결됨' + '다른 휴대폰 연결' = reissueClaim -> onClaimUrl + QR opens; category rail with aria-current; 2-col ProductTile grid 272px photo, badge, sold-out/out-of-hours overlay, disabled; AI change via render-time lastChange diff: 2 s k-ring on tile and chip, aria-live status 'AI가 담았어요: …' for voice/text only, category switch unless sheet open or touch in last 5 s; optimistic pending lines kept until stream cartVersion reaches the reply, rolled back on error; ConfirmClear -> clearCart; 주문하기 -> requestCheckout), CartBar, ProductSheet (defaults preselected, variant unselected, required needs min, max>1 multi, sold-out disabled, check mark + 6px border + tint ring, qty stepper, live price), UpsellPopup (only from this kiosk's touch addToCart reply), styles.ts (FOCUS, SCRIM). hooks/useQrSrc.ts moved out of KioskScreen. KioskScreen.send now returns CommandReply|null; new prop onClaimUrl (KioskApp passes setClaimUrl); Header exported with children. globals.css k-ring (static with reduced motion). I-034 logged (no dine buttons when requestCheckout returns pick_dine; for step 3). Not viewed in a browser yet (Playwright in step 5).

steps.name: kiosk-checkout
steps.summary: K6/K7/K8/KX + demo counters. src/lib/kiosk/timers.ts (18 tests): idleWarning (last 60 s, only connected/ordering/confirming/paying), phonePaused (phoneSeenAt, else phoneConnectedAt, > 60 s; not in paid/expired), staffBannerVisible (60 s), doneCountdown (10 s); all take server time = now + clockOffset. hooks/useNow.ts (1 s clock). components/kiosk: KioskToolbar (dine chip + small QR/QrSheet or 'phone connected' + [다른 휴대폰 연결], hidden in paying/paid; moved out of MenuScreen) on K3/K6/K7; ReviewScreen (lines with photo, -/+ updateCart, - at 1 opens remove dialog -> removeFromCart, dine option, total k-text-72 Space Grotesk, [메뉴 더 담기]=cancelCheckout, [결제하기]=confirmCheckout touch with session cartVersion, one command at a time); PaymentScreen (method: 카드 enabled, 간편결제/쿠폰 disabled '지원하지 않아요'; insert: slot drawing + arrow + k-card-insert 0.5 s alternate slide (globals.css, none under reduced motion) + [카드 넣기]; approving 1.5 s then cardAction, back to insert on error; [주문 수정]=editOrder in method/insert; total always shown); DoneScreen (receipt question with its own visible 10 s countdown that moves on to the number, never to K1; order number 240px; role=timer '10초 후 처음 화면으로 돌아가요' counted from when the number appears; calls onNewSession once at 0); KioskBanners (staff by reasonCode, phone paused, idle alertdialog with [계속하기] = ping active:true; fixed copy in i18n/kiosk.ts); DemoCounter (demo=1 only, taps = pointerdown on enabled buttons outside K1 and K8, time from first such tap, frozen at paid, data-taps/data-seconds, data-demo-counter). KioskScreen: new prop clockOffset (KioskApp passes ks.clockOffset), send(type,args,{cartVersion}), screenSoon placeholder removed, I-034 fixed (pick_dine error bar shows dine buttons -> setDineOption then requestCheckout). I-036 logged (K6 qty change returns to K3, server rule). API smoke test passed (touch order through editOrder to paid, /kiosk 200). Not viewed in a browser yet (Playwright in step 5).

steps.name: kiosk-e2e
steps.summary: Playwright Test E2E for /kiosk (4 tests, Chromium, 1080x1920). playwright.config.ts: testDir e2e, workers 1 (shared per-IP limit), webServer 'npm run dev -- --port 3100' with STORE=memory, traces on first retry; package.json test:e2e; @playwright/test dev dep; test-results/ and playwright-report/ git-ignored; Vitest include stays src/**. e2e/helpers.ts: kioskRoot ([data-screen]), buttonWithText (button containing an exact text, inner locator rooted at the page), readClaim (img[data-claim-url] -> sessionId, claimToken), claim, command (uuid commandId, Bearer, asserts ok), storedKioskSession (localStorage kibo.kiosk.malo). kiosk-touch.spec: hero order on /kiosk?k=malo&demo=1; 'both fries to large' = [전체 삭제] + re-add both sets with fries L (no option edit on cart lines, I-039); asserts requestCheckout reply total 14800, 2 review lines, '14,800원', payment -> card -> 승인 중… -> 출력 안 함 -> 주문 번호 + timer; writes evidence/touch-hero.json on every run (41 taps; seconds are Playwright speed). kiosk-mirror.spec: claim via HTTP, voice addToCart -> K3 with k-ring tile and 'AI가 담았어요', setDineOption + requestCheckout -> review, button confirmCheckout -> payment, second claim 409 'Someone else is using this kiosk.'. kiosk-states.spec: 새우버거 disabled with 품절; 에그 머핀 '지금은 판매하지 않아요' (skipped 05:00-10:30 KST); paid via kiosk-token API -> countdown -> attract with a new QR. Kiosk fixes: I-037 MenuScreen replays a lastChange under 2 s old at mount (new clockOffset prop), so the phone's first add that opens K3 rings; I-038 DemoCounter key 'counter:<id>' (duplicate key with DoneScreen). I-039 logged (touch tap count inflated by clear-and-re-add; decide before 10/16). TESTING ledger row added. E2E passed twice in a row.

steps.name: ui-qa-setup
steps.summary: Automated UI QA (docs/UI_QA.md 'Automating'). axe-core dev dep (npm package, injected with addScriptTag). playwright.qa.config.ts: testDir e2e/qa, port 3200 dev server STORE=memory, workers 1, metadata.qaOut = phases/<phase>/qa when the branch is feat-<phase> and the folder exists (PHASE env overrides), else qa-output/; global-setup clears ui-qa.jsonl. playwright.config.ts now testIgnore 'qa/**' (it had run the QA specs and written a stray untracked undefined/ folder at the repo root: delete by hand, I-046; checks now throw without qaOut). e2e/qa/checks.ts: KIOSK (canvas 1080, font 40, target 40) and PHONE (16, 56) profiles; axe (wcag2a/aa, 21a/aa, 22aa, target-size on, nextjs-portal excluded; incomplete contrast -> T human review), fonts (H min computed size, already canvas px; T <= 4 sizes ignoring >= 100px, body line-height >= 1.5), targets (H size and >= 8px gap, only hit-testable controls, rects / canvas scale), reflow 320 (phone only), textSpacing (H, WCAG 1.4.12 CSS, clipped overflow hidden), focus (H Tab loop, outline >= 2px or box-shadow, elementFromPoint), tokens (T motion <= 500ms except .k-ring, spacing in 0/4/8/12/16/24/32/48/64), reducedMotion (T, H for k-card-insert); qaState(page, info, profile, state, {reflow, afterShot}) screenshots then checks and appends {route,state,viewport,h,t,shots}; qaShot screenshot only. e2e/qa/kiosk.qa.spec.ts: 3 tests, 15 states (K1, K1 600x1067 shot, K2, K3 sold-out, K4 variant/drink-empty/ingredients, K5, K6 2 lines, K7 card insert, K8 receipt/order number, K3 AI highlight via phone addToCart, KX staff via phone callStaff, KX idle warning via page.clock.setSystemTime +9.5 min); K8 order number moves the page clock back 60 s after the screenshot so the countdown cannot end (pausing would stop axe). npm run qa:ui; QA_ALL=1 fails on T too. H fixed: focus obscured under scrims (I-040) -> ModalLayer + hooks/useInertBackground make the rest of the canvas inert; used by ProductSheet, UpsellPopup, ConfirmClear, remove dialog, QrSheet, idle warning. T logged: I-041 line-height 1.35/1.3, I-042 40px/96px spacing, I-043 contrast human review, I-044 K1 hint orphan '요' (needs keep-all), I-045 AI pill covers first tile row. UI_QA 'In place' note, UI_GUIDE inert line. Screenshots viewed: K1, K3 highlight, K6, K8 look right; issues are I-044, I-045. All AC pass: lint, build, test (281), test:e2e (4), qa:ui (0 H).
